On the plate

Photos from the restaurant’s Google listing.

Gary’s on Nissi Avenue

Gary’s Bar & Grill has been on Nissi Avenue in Ayia Napa since 1989: a covered terrace under the green awning, wooden chairs, chalkboards with the breakfast menu and screens for the matches. On Google, guests write that they have breakfast here every day of their holiday and that they come back year after year. Next to the English breakfast, the menu has pancakes, bagels, grill, Cypriot dishes and vegan options.

Open every day from 8:30 in the morning until 4 in the afternoon.
